purpose: Unify the surviving rank-3 switch, read-2 squarefree-monomial, rainbow-selection, and three-way constraint views into one canonical partition-matroid carrier. The aim is to isolate exactly which local exchange defect remains after bounded-occurrence normalization, without claiming a polynomial solver.

input_normal_form.formula: A 2/3-CNF in which every Boolean variable occurs at most three times, obtained by the standard polynomial bounded-occurrence normalization used by the parent artifacts.
input_normal_form.ground_set: One element for every literal occurrence. A selected element means that this literal occurrence is chosen as the witness satisfying its clause.
input_normal_form.witness_criterion: The CNF is satisfiable iff there exists a set S containing exactly one literal occurrence from every clause and never containing both signs of the same original variable.

M_C.blocks: The literal occurrences of each clause form one partition block of capacity 1.
M_C.role: Independence in M_C means at most one witness occurrence per clause. A common independent set of cardinality equal to the number of clauses therefore chooses exactly one occurrence from every clause.

M_L.degree3_mixed_variable: After possibly negating the variable, let L,R be its two majority-sign occurrences and M its one minority-sign occurrence. Put {L,M} in one capacity-1 block; all other occurrences of that variable are singleton blocks.
M_L.degree2_mixed_variable: Put the two opposite-sign occurrences in one capacity-1 block.

M_R.degree3_mixed_variable: For the same L,R,M put {R,M} in one capacity-1 block; all other occurrences are singleton blocks.
M_R.degree2_mixed_variable: Use singleton blocks here; the conflict is already enforced in M_L.

three_partition_matroids.pair_block_overlap: The union of nontrivial pair blocks from M_L and M_R is a disjoint union of P3 components L-M-R for mixed degree-3 variables and K2 components for mixed degree-2 variables.

theorem.name: SAT_IFF_P3_OVERLAP_THREE_PARTITION_COMMON_INDEPENDENT_SET
theorem.statement: Let m be the number of clauses. The normalized CNF F is satisfiable iff there exists S with |S|=m that is independent in M_C, M_L, and M_R.
proof: If F is satisfiable, choose one true literal occurrence from each clause. Then |S|=m and M_C-independence is immediate. No variable contributes occurrences of both signs, so no conflict pair {L,M}, {R,M}, or degree-2 opposite-sign pair is selected; hence S is independent in M_L and M_R.
Conversely, let S be common independent with |S|=m. M_C has exactly m capacity-1 clause blocks, so S contains exactly one occurrence from every clause.

For a mixed degree-3 variable, M_L forbids selecting L together with M and M_R forbids selecting R together with M. Therefore S may select any subset of the two majority occurrences, or the minority occurrence, but never both signs.
For a mixed degree-2 variable, M_L forbids selecting its two opposite-sign occurrences. Pure/singleton variables create no sign conflict.

Thus the chosen one-per-clause witness set is sign-consistent for every original variable. Assign each variable according to the selected sign when present, arbitrarily otherwise. Every clause contains its selected true witness, so F is satisfied.

local_rank3_switch_relation.interpretation: This is exactly the intersection of the two capacity-1 pair constraints {L,M} and {R,M}.

delta_matroid_failure.statement: For every v in X symmetric-difference Y, X symmetric-difference {u,v} is infeasible (with v=u meaning toggle u once). Therefore the symmetric-exchange axiom fails.

local_rank3_switch_relation.minimality: The three missing subsets are {L,M}, {M,R}, and {L,M,R}. Adding any one of these to the five-state feasible family yields a six-state family satisfying the symmetric-exchange axiom; the checker exhaustively verifies all three cases.

equivalent_views.read2_squarefree: The same occurrence witnesses are terms in the read-at-most-two Pi-Sigma_3-Pi_2 carrier; squarefreeness is exactly absence of the pair conflicts encoded by M_L and M_R.
equivalent_views.conflict_graph: Pair conflicts form disjoint P3/K2 components. Independent witness selection chooses one vertex from each clause color class while staying independent in this conflict graph.
equivalent_views.rainbow_matching: Because a disjoint union of P3/K2 conflict components is a line graph of a disjoint union of P4/P3 components, the carrier is equivalently a clause-colored rainbow matching problem on that linear forest.
equivalent_views.rank3_switch: Each mixed degree-3 Boolean variable is exactly the 2-vs-1 rank-3 switch isolated by the v1.4 determinant formulation.

algorithmic_consequence.positive: All local variable-side structure is now partition-matroidal and pairwise; the only non-delta local atom is one three-port exchange defect.
algorithmic_consequence.not_a_solver: Intersection of three partition matroids is not generically polynomial-time, and this artifact does not prove that the P3-overlap restriction makes it polynomial.
anti_loop: Do not treat ordinary two-matroid intersection as directly applicable: M_L intersection M_R is not itself a matroid/delta-matroid on the rank-3 switch.
Do not branch over the three missing local states independently; that is exponential in the number of degree-3 mixed variables.
Do not replace exact common independence by linear span, parity, or hash reachability; frozen counterexamples already invalidate those relaxations.

next_target.name: E8_P3_OVERLAP_AUGMENTING_EXCHANGE_THEOREM_V2_5
next_target.directive: Construct a deterministic polynomial augmentation theorem for common independent sets of (M_C,M_L,M_R) using that all nontrivial M_L/M_R blocks have size two and their overlap graph is a disjoint union of P3/K2. The theorem must either increase cardinality or return an exact obstruction certificate, without branching over rank-3 switches.
next_target.required_progress_measure: A polynomially bounded potential Phi(S) and an augmentation/obstruction procedure whose every successful step strictly improves Phi or |S|, with at most poly(|F|) distinct steps.
success_obligations: polynomially discoverable UNSAT obstruction or exact no-augmentation certificate
no hidden exponential branching, state space, field extension, coefficient bitlength, or oracle

scientific_ceiling.NEW_EXACT_FRONTIER: P3-overlap common-independent-set problem for three partition matroids, with one local symmetric-exchange defect per mixed degree-3 variable.
